questions.stem: Why is a pie chart not suitable for data with many categories (e.g. $20$ different items)?

options.text: The angles would not add up to $360°$
The sectors would be too small to read and compare
You cannot calculate angles for more than $10$ items
Pie charts can only show $4$ categories

questions.explanation: With many categories, the sectors become very thin, making it difficult to read the chart or compare the sizes of similar sectors. A bar chart would be more appropriate.
